# Read the plink file and set 6th col to 1

check and remove any snps without a map position

```{r}
# read resrepo::path_resrepo("data/intermediate/rbind_data/rbind_sort_dist/mad_bor_g1000_sum.fam")
mad_bor_g1000_sum_fam <- read.table(resrepo::path_resrepo("data/intermediate/rbind_data/rbind_sort_dist/mad_bor_g1000_sum.fam"), header = FALSE, sep = " ")
#mad_bor_g1000_sum_fam$V6 <- 1

# colnames of $V1 to "id"
colnames(mad_bor_g1000_sum_fam)[1] <- "id"
# colnames of $V6 to "population"
colnames(mad_bor_g1000_sum_fam)[6] <- "population"

pop_table <- read.table(path_resrepo("data/raw/data_input/Madagascar_Borneo.poptable"), sep = "\t", fill = TRUE)
colnames(pop_table) <- c("IID", "V2","FID","Population","V5","V6","V7")

#Remove the "RR"
mad_bor_g1000_sum_fam$id <- sub("RR.*", "", mad_bor_g1000_sum_fam$id)
mad_bor_g1000_sum_fam$V2 <- sub("RR.*", "", mad_bor_g1000_sum_fam$V2)

#Find Malagasy entries 
pop_table_sub <- subset(pop_table,pop_table$IID %in% mad_bor_g1000_sum_fam$id)

#match up the ID's with pop table metadata
matching_m <- match(mad_bor_g1000_sum_fam$id, pop_table_sub$IID)

mad_bor_g1000_sum_fam$population <- ifelse(!is.na(matching_m), pop_table_sub$Population[matching_m], mad_bor_g1000_sum_fam$population)


# replace any _ with a space
#mad_bor_g1000_sum_fam$population <- gsub("_", " ", mad_bor_g1000_sum_fam$population)

# replace any " " in $populaiton with a "_"
mad_bor_g1000_sum_fam$population <- gsub(" ", "_", mad_bor_g1000_sum_fam$population)

# any $id begining GRC has $population "Sumba"
mad_bor_g1000_sum_fam$population[grepl("^GRC", mad_bor_g1000_sum_fam$id)] <- "Sumba"

# Load fastmixture results
mad_bor_g1000_sum <- gt_load(path_resrepo("data/intermediate/rbind_data/mad_bor_g1000_sum.gt"))
#qmats <- readRDS(path_resrepo("data/intermediate/fastmixture/fastmixture_m.RData"))
qmats <- readRDS("~/Dropbox/gitdata/malagasy_diversity/data/intermediate/fastmixture/fastmixture_m.RData")
# tidy with the gt
mad_bor_g1000_sum <- augment(get_q_matrix(qmats, k = 3, run = 1), data = mad_bor_g1000_sum)
# filter to merina
merina <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>% filter(population == "Merina")
# split groups
merina$population <- ifelse(merina$.Q3 > 0.5, "MerinaA", "MerinaB")
merina <- merina[,c("id","population")]
merina$id <- sub("RR.*", "", merina$id)

# match mad_bor_g1000_sum_fam$id to merina$id
#merina_matches <-which(mad_bor_g1000_sum_fam$id == merina$id)
# add $population to mad_bor_g1000_sum_fam
#mad_bor_g1000_sum_fam[c(merina_matches),]$population <- merina$population

# match V2 and merina$id and replace the population column in merina_fam with the population column in merina
matching_m <- match(mad_bor_g1000_sum_fam$id, merina$id)
mad_bor_g1000_sum_fam$population <- ifelse(!is.na(matching_m), merina$population[matching_m], mad_bor_g1000_sum_fam$population)

#mad_bor_g1000_sum_fam$id <- as.numeric(rownames(mad_bor_g1000_sum_fam))
mad_bor_g1000_sum_fam$population <- as.factor(mad_bor_g1000_sum_fam$population)

#mad_bor_g1000_sum_fam$V6 <- mad_bor_g1000_sum_fam$population
write.table(mad_bor_g1000_sum_fam, resrepo::path_resrepo("data/intermediate/rbind_data/rbind_sort_dist/mad_bor_g1000_sum.fam"), row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE, sep = " ", quote = FALSE)
```

# Write a test bash script for ALDER

mindis: 0.005 - minimum genetic distance (in Morgans) at which to start curve fitting (default: determined using LD correlation). 
https://comppopgenworkshop2019.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contents/06_alder/alder.html 
States that the default calculates the correlation in LD decay between the target and each reference, and uses 'the minimum distance that shows no correlation in both references.' 
'If it continues beyond 2 cM (due to either a strong bottleneck or admixture in a reference), the program aborts.'
In example with Merina as Target and Esan and Borneo as reference, setting mindis to default causes the program to abort.
What does mindis do to the results?


jackknife: YES - outputs results from leave-one-chromosome-out jackknifing

For now, using checkmap: NO - why does our map have an issue?

binsize: 0.0005 default - genetic distance resolution (in Morgans) - the size of bins that ALDER splits the genome up into, used to calculate the distance between the bins of two snps as opposed to the distance between the each individual pair of snps, for computational efficiency 

# Run bash scripts

```{bash}
cd ~/Git/malagasy_diversity/code
alder -p s11b_alder_merina_a.par > s11b_alder_merina_a.log
alder -p s11b_alder_merina_b.par > s11b_alder_merina_b.log
alder -p s11b_alder_mikea.par > s11b_alder_mikea.log
alder -p s11b_alder_vezo.par > s11b_alder_vezo.log
alder -p s11b_alder_temoro.par > s11b_alder_temoro.log
alder -p s11b_alder_betsileo.par > s11b_alder_betsileo.log
alder -p s11b_alder_betsimisaraka.par > s11b_alder_betsimisaraka.log

```

# Example plot 

Using https://comppopgenworkshop2019.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contents/06_alder/alder.html 

E[Y] = M times e^-nd + K

```{r}
fn1 = "../results/s11_ALDER/alder_merina.txt"

n = 25.17    ## decay parameter - the estimate for admixture date
M = 0.00153897  ## amp_exp
K = 0.00040424  ## amp_aff

d1 = read.table(fn1, header = F)
d1 <- d1[-nrow(d1),]
colnames(d1) = c("Dist", "weightedLD", "npairs")
xv = as.vector(d1$Dist)        ## distance between SNP bins (cM)
yv = as.vector(d1$weightedLD)  ## Weighted LD
#fv = as.vector(d1$use) == "Y"  ## a boolean vector marking if each bin is used in fitting
prdv = M * exp(-1 * n * xv / 100) + K # E[Y] = M times e^-nd + K

dev.new()
plot(xv, yv, xlab="Genetic distance (cM)", ylab = "weighted LD", main = "Merina", pch=4, col="blue")
points(xv, prdv, type="l", lwd=1.5, col="red")
```

# Boxplot

```{r}
files <- list.files(
    resrepo::path_resrepo("code"),
    pattern = ".log",
    full.names = TRUE
)

# use readLines to read each of files
logs <- lapply(files, readLines)


# Extract "DATA:" lines from each log file in the list
data_lines <- lapply(logs, function(log_file) log_file[grepl("^DATA:", log_file, ignore.case = TRUE)])

# create a dataframe 

# Extract the first line from each element in data_lines
first_lines <- sapply(data_lines, function(x) if (length(x) > 0) x[1] else NA)

# Split each first "DATA:" line by backslash "\\"
split_data <- lapply(first_lines, function(x) strsplit(x, "\t")[[1]])

result <- do.call(rbind, split_data)
result <- as.data.frame(result, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
# remove NA row
result <- result[complete.cases(result),]
print(result)
```

```{r}

# split $V11 into 3 columns 

split_dates <- do.call(rbind,strsplit(result$V11, " "))
#remove the middle column
split_dates <- split_dates[,-2]
# add column names
colnames(split_dates) <- c("admixture_date", "CI")
# turn into a dataframe
split_dates <- as.data.frame(split_dates)
# make numeric
split_dates$admixture_date <- as.numeric(split_dates$admixture_date)
split_dates$CI <- as.numeric(split_dates$CI)
result <- cbind(result,split_dates)
```


```{r}
result$V4 <- factor(result$V4,  levels=c("Temoro","Betsimisaraka","MerinaA","Betsileo","Mikea","Merina","MerinaB","Sakalava_Tsimihety","Vezo","Diego"))

ggplot(result,aes(x = V4, y = admixture_date, colour = V4)) + 
  geom_boxplot() + 
  scale_y_continuous(
    "Admixture date (generations ago)", 
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . * 25, name = "Admixture date (years BP)")
  ) + 
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = admixture_date - CI, ymax = admixture_date + CI), width = 0.2) + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank())+
  labs(x = "Population", y = "Admixture date (generations ago)", colour = "Population")#+
  #scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2")

ggsave(paste0(res_dir, "alder_results.jpg"), width = 7, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```

# Analysis splitting Merina

```{r}
mad_bor_g1000_sum <- gt_load(path_resrepo("data/intermediate/rbind_data/mad_bor_g1000_sum.gt"))
#qmats <- readRDS(path_resrepo("data/intermediate/fastmixture/fastmixture_m.RData"))

qmats <- readRDS("~/Dropbox/gitdata/malagasy_diversity/data/intermediate/fastmixture/fastmixture_m.RData")
# match the qmats to the gt by $id

# tidy with the gt
mad_bor_g1000_sum <- augment(get_q_matrix(qmats, k = 3, run = 1), data = mad_bor_g1000_sum)

# filter to merina
merina <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>% filter(population == "Merina")

# split groups
merina$group <- ifelse(merina$.Q3 > 0.5, "Social group A", "Social group B")
merina_a <- merina %>% filter(group == "Social group A")
merina_b <- merina %>% filter(group == "Social group B")

```
